Committee: County and Municipal Government
Sponsor: Sorrell
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 02/22/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 371 as introduced will increase the expenditures of the Secretary of State by an estimated $50,000 to initially create, and $25,000 annually, to operate a public notice website, or contract with a third party to do the same. This increase in expenditures may be offset, in whole or in part, by the fees collected by the Secretary of State from the authorized person or entity providing the notices to be published on the website.
Also, this bill would increase the obligations of each county commission and governing body of municipalities that elect to publish public notices online pursuant to this bill by a small undetermined amount to publish a public notice regarding the change to Internet publication of public notices.
Reed Ingram, Chair
County and Municipal Government

Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
Sponsor: Gaston
Analyst: Robin Rawls
Date: 02/25/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 69 as passed the House of Representatives provides for the continuance of the Alabama Board of Examiners for Speech-Language Pathology and audiology until October 1, 2025 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
